solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Embrace more than once, even in a race

definitions.meaning: to neck is to kiss and cuddle, and doing it twice over gives the phrase with the verb repeated and joined
racers level with each other at the line are said to be in a dead heat, side by side

explanation.surface: A clue that seems to celebrate repeated hugging during a race.
explanation.definitionFit: Two runners locked level in a race are said to be running side by side with heads together, the idiom for a dead heat.

clue.text: The viewers have a point, certainly

parts.note: a point of the compass, here east
yes, certainly

explanation.surface: Viewers of a show are being agreed with.
explanation.definitionFit: The eyes are the organs we look with, so they are the body's viewers.

clue.text: Old acquaintance

parts.note: an archaic word for one's friends and neighbours, surviving mainly in a phrase paired with relatives

explanation.definitionFit: This archaic word meant one's friends and acquaintances, now heard almost only alongside 'kin'.

clue.text: Hastened up with class report

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: ran means hastened
rate means class, as in first-rate

explanation.surface: Someone hurried upstairs with the class report.
explanation.definitionFit: To report events is to tell or recount them as a story.

clue.text: Record a piece of music

definitions.meaning: a single musical sound or its written symbol

explanation.surface: Making a recording of a musical piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To jot something down is to write it, and a single tone in music has the same name.

clue.text: Soldiers shout about naval lack of leadership

indicators.note: says the shout goes around the other piece

parts.note: cry means shout

indicators.note: the word naval loses its leading letter

explanation.surface: Soldiers complain that the navy has no leaders.
explanation.definitionFit: Cavalry are soldiers on horseback, or nowadays in armoured vehicles.

clue.text: Where Homer's about to jump the green

parts.note: spring means jump
a green or field is a grassy open area

explanation.surface: The epic poet seems about to leap over the grass.
explanation.walkthrough: Homer here is Homer Simpson, whose cartoon family live in this town, not the Greek poet; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The animated Simpsons family lives in a fictional town of this name.

clue.text: Daybreak?

parts.note: read the word as a break in the day, a crack, giving the phrase for first light

explanation.definitionFit: First light at sunrise is called by this idiom, the moment the day first appears.

clue.text: Mast bearing standard

parts.note: a compass bearing such as south, abbreviated to its initial
par is the standard or normal level

explanation.surface: A ship's mast carrying a flag.
explanation.definitionFit: A spar is a pole such as a mast or boom used in rigging a sailing ship.

clue.text: Overrates it as a medicine

indicators.note: the short link signals that the letters are recast, read as 'remade as', a loose anagram signal in this older clue

explanation.surface: Someone thinks a remedy is overhyped.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal is unusually faint: 'as' asks you to turn the letters of OVERRATES IT into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tonic or remedy that restores health is called by this name, a noun as well as an adjective.

clue.text: Record is within a couple of figures

indicators.note: says the word is goes inside the two figures

parts.note: two Roman numerals, D for five hundred and C for one hundred

explanation.surface: A recording's catalogue number has only two digits.
explanation.definitionFit: A gramophone record is a flat disc, so the shape stands for the recording.

clue.text: Insignificant boxer

definitions.meaning: a fighter in one of the lighter weight divisions

explanation.surface: A boxer of no importance.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of little consequence is called this, and it is also a boxing weight class.

clue.text: Cannot compare with a description of Nelson's left eye

definitions.text: a description of Nelson's left eye
definitions.meaning: Admiral Nelson lost the sight of one eye, but the other, his good eye, wore no covering

explanation.surface: A comparison involving the famous admiral's eyes.
explanation.walkthrough: Horatio Nelson, the British admiral, was blinded in his right eye; his left, the good one, wore no eyepatch.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying one thing is far inferior to another uses this idiom of a scrap of cloth.

clue.text: Cut off, and also tie off

indicators.note: something gone off has gone wrong or bad, telling us to rearrange the letters

explanation.surface: Instructions for snipping and knotting a thread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' appears twice; the first belongs to the definition, the second is the anagram signal on ALSO TIE.
explanation.definitionFit: To isolate something is to separate it and cut it off from others.

clue.text: Features about fifty members of the House of Lords

definitions.text: members of the House of Lords

indicators.note: says the features go around the other piece

parts.note: ears are facial features
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Fifty peers' faces are described.
explanation.definitionFit: Earls are peers of the realm, who sat in Britain's upper chamber.

clue.text: Stop for Jack to revive

definitions.meaning: Jack is a sailor, and in nautical language a ship is halted by turning it into the wind
to bring someone round after fainting

explanation.surface: A sailor halts to give someone first aid.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack (Jack Tar) is a sailor; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Bringing a vessel to is the nautical term for halting it, and bringing a person to means restoring consciousness.

clue.text: Composer's state of ignorance

definitions.meaning: Sir Arthur ..., the English composer; the 's stands for is
from the saying that ignorance is perfect happiness

explanation.surface: A musician's lack of knowledge.
explanation.definitionFit: Arthur Bliss was Master of the Queen's Music, and the proverb says not knowing brings perfect happiness.

clue.text: Run relay in good time

indicators.note: to run something can mean to manage or set it going in a new way, here a recasting of the letters

explanation.surface: Advice to a relay team to start promptly.
explanation.definitionFit: Arriving with time to spare means arriving ahead of schedule, before the due moment.

clue.text: Come before the school principal

definitions.meaning: to lead or be at the front of a list or queue
the teacher in charge of a school, as in headteacher

explanation.surface: Appearing in front of the headteacher for discipline.
explanation.definitionFit: To lead a procession is to be at its front, and the head is the chief teacher of a school.

clue.text: Tighten the spring — it's a means of propulsion

definitions.meaning: to turn the key of a clock or toy until its spring is taut
moving air that drives sailing ships and windmills

explanation.surface: A clockwork toy is being explained.
explanation.definitionFit: Clockwork is primed by turning a key, and breezes drive sails, two unrelated senses of one spelling.

clue.text: As cheer-leader the girl shows form

parts.note: the leading letter of the word cheer
lass is a girl, especially in northern England and Scotland

explanation.surface: A cheerleading girl displays good shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cheer-leader' reads as the pom-pom performer, but it means the first letter of cheer.
explanation.definitionFit: A form is a school year group, and a class is the same grouping of pupils.

clue.text: Cup of tea left to go cold

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea
to ice over is to turn cold

explanation.surface: A cup of tea is left to cool down.
explanation.definitionFit: A chalice is a goblet or ceremonial cup, as used for communion wine.

clue.text: He cuts inside the fold

parts.note: a fold is a sheep pen, and the man who clips fleeces there works within it

explanation.definitionFit: A person who clips the wool from sheep is described, the fold being their pen.

clue.text: From this raw spirits are made

indicators.note: says the letters of the phrase this raw are made into something new

explanation.surface: A recipe line for distilling spirits from raw ingredients.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirits' looks like liquor in the surface, but it means ghosts.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghostly apparitions or spectres of people are called by this plural name.

clue.text: Everything in the performance is superficial

indicators.note: says one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a show is a stage performance
all means everything

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses a whole show as lacking depth.
explanation.definitionFit: A person or idea lacking depth is called by the same word used for water that is not deep.

clue.text: I can upset a Peruvian

indicators.note: means the letters of the two words are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone boasts they can annoy a man from Peru.
explanation.definitionFit: The Incas were the native people whose empire was centred on Peru.

clue.text: Politician is about to see mischief-makers

indicators.note: says the word is goes around the politician

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An MP is going to meet troublemakers.
explanation.definitionFit: Imps are small devils, and the word is used for mischievous children.

clue.text: Rudder made of hard wood

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
elm is a kind of wood

explanation.surface: A ship's rudder carved from hardwood.
explanation.definitionFit: The helm is the steering gear of a ship, its tiller or wheel and rudder.

clue.text: A form of need where there was none

indicators.note: a form of the word need is a rearrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: A place where want was unknown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'none' refers back to need: the garden of paradise lacked nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical garden of paradise provided everything, so no want existed there.

clue.text: More than mere business acquaintances

parts.note: a firm is a business, so people who are companions within a company might be called this, yet the phrase also means close and loyal pals

explanation.surface: Colleagues who have become close.
explanation.definitionFit: Loyal, steadfast companions are described with this phrase meaning strong friendship.

clue.text: The ring Winnie returned

indicators.note: turned back, so the name is read from right to left

parts.note: Winnie-the-Pooh, the bear of A. A. Milne's stories

explanation.surface: A ring that Winnie gave back.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoop is a circular band, a ring of wood or metal.

clue.text: Capacity of certain players in the new team

indicators.note: says the two pieces go inside another
a new version of the word team, its letters rearranged

parts.note: sure means certain
men are the players of a team or pieces in a game

explanation.surface: How good certain players are when slotted into a new side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capacity' sounds like a talent of the players, but it is the definition: a volume or size that can be gauged.
explanation.definitionFit: Capacity is a size or volume, an amount that can be measured.
